en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on the Perception of a Bowl.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were eating almsfood while looking here and there; they did not even notice when it was being scattered or when it had passed them.
… [as above] … “The training is to be observed: ‘I will eat almsfood with mindfulness directed to the bowl.
Almsfood should be eaten with mindfulness directed to the bowl.”
If one, out of disrespect, eats almsfood while looking here and there, it is an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth].
the second training rule is concluded.
